privacyPage.metaDescription: Mega Cars sets only one strictly necessary cookie for your language choice and uses no analytics tools. Here you can read which data is processed for hosting, for the map and for your enquiries.
privacyPage.title: This is how we handle your data.
privacyPage.lead: This website sets only one strictly necessary cookie for your language choice, no analytics tools and no advertising services. We only process the data needed to deliver the website and to answer your enquiries.
privacyPage.translationNote: This English version is provided for your convenience; the German version is authoritative.
privacyPage.controllerP1: The controller for data processing on this website is Mega Cars Murat Demir e.U., owner Murat Demir, Radetzkystraße 80, 6845 Hohenems, Austria.
privacyPage.controllerP2: You can reach us by phone on +43 660 6877002 and by e-mail at megacars@live.at.
privacyPage.hostingP1: The website is hosted by Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Avenue #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. When you open a page, Vercel processes technically necessary data such as your IP address, the approximate location derived from it, the address requested, the date and time, and details of your browser and operating system.
privacyPage.hostingP2: We need this data to deliver the website securely and reliably. The legal basis is our legitimate interest under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Depending on the Vercel plan, our project’s logs remain available for between one hour and 30 days.
privacyPage.hostingP3: Vercel participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and provides for the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses in its data processing addendum. You can read more in Vercel’s privacy policy at vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy.
privacyPage.databaseTitle: Where is the vehicle data kept?
privacyPage.databaseP1: The vehicle data and vehicle photos on this website are kept in a database and a photo store of Supabase Pte. Ltd., 65 Chulia Street #38-02/03, OCBC Centre, Singapore 049513, run in the Frankfurt am Main region (European Union). When you open a page, your browser loads the photos from there; Supabase processes technically necessary data such as your IP address, the requested file and the date and time.
privacyPage.databaseP2: We use this service as a processor so that we can maintain our stock ourselves and the website runs reliably. The legal basis is our legitimate interest under Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Supabase is bound by a data processing agreement that includes the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses; details are available at supabase.com/legal/privacy and supabase.com/legal/dpa.
privacyPage.fontsTitle: Which fonts and content are loaded?
privacyPage.fontsP1: The website delivers its fonts, photos, videos and program code from its own server. The Unbounded and Hanken Grotesk fonts are built into the website; your browser does not connect to Google for them.
privacyPage.mapP1: On the home page and the contact page you first see only a drawing of the surrounding area, delivered from our own server. No data is passed to third parties.
privacyPage.mapP2: Only when you click “Load map” is the interactive map of the OpenStreetMap Foundation, St John’s Innovation Centre, Cowley Road, Cambridge, CB4 0WS, United Kingdom, loaded. The OpenStreetMap Foundation then receives in particular your IP address, details of your browser and device, and the page requested. The legal basis is the consent you give by clicking, under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR; the European Commission has adopted an adequacy decision for the United Kingdom. You will find details at osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy.
privacyPage.mapP3: The “Plan your route” link opens Google Maps in a new window. Data only goes to Google once you click the link.
privacyPage.contactP1: Our forms neither store nor send anything themselves. They turn your details into a finished message that opens in WhatsApp or in your e-mail program; it is only sent once you tap Send there.
privacyPage.contactP2: If you write to us on WhatsApp, your message is transmitted via WhatsApp Ireland Limited, Merrion Road, Dublin 4, D04 X2K5, Ireland, and WhatsApp’s privacy policy applies. If you e-mail or call us, we receive your details that way.
privacyPage.contactP3: We use your details only to answer your enquiry and to prepare a possible transaction (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We delete them as soon as they are no longer needed for that purpose, unless statutory retention obligations apply, such as the seven years under § 132 of the Austrian Federal Fiscal Code (BAO) for business records.
privacyPage.cookiesP1: Only one, and it is strictly necessary: when you choose a language in the language switch, the cookie “NEXT_LOCALE” remembers that choice for one year, so that you read in your language straight away on your next visit. It contains nothing but the language code (de, en or tr) and is not passed on to anyone.
privacyPage.cookiesP2: Under § 165(3) of the Austrian Telecommunications Act 2021 (TKG 2021) this cookie needs no consent, which is why you do not see a cookie notice. Beyond that, the website stores nothing on your device and uses no analytics, tracking or advertising tools. You can delete the cookie in your browser at any time.
privacyPage.cookiesP3: Our vehicle management area at the address /admin is intended for our staff only. Anyone who signs in there with an e-mail address and password receives technically necessary login cookies (their names begin with “sb-”) that keep the session until sign-out. Visitors to the website do not receive these cookies.
privacyPage.linksP1: Links to WhatsApp, Google Maps, OpenStreetMap and Galzura open those providers’ pages. Data only goes to them once you click such a link; from then on their own privacy policies apply.
privacyPage.rightsP1: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing, the right to data portability and the right to object (Art. 15 to 21 GDPR). You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time with effect for the future.
privacyPage.rightsP2: To do so, simply write to us at megacars@live.at.
privacyPage.rightsP3: If you believe that we are not processing your data lawfully, you can lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority: Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, dsb@dsb.gv.at, www.dsb.gv.at.
